name: Lake Shore Realty Limited
about: Lake Shore Realty Limited engages in the real estate business in India. It Is involved in the development and management of projects relating to real estate, infrastructure, hospitality, education, healthcare, industrial warehousing, etc. The company was formerly known as Mahaan Foods Limited and changed its name to Lake Shore Realty Limited in April 2025. Lake Shore Realty Limited was incorporated in 1987 and is based in New Delhi, India.
